Name: Open Frame Data Center Rack 48U x 24"W x 42"D
Natural: Our Data Center Open Frame server racks are compatible with Dell, HP and IBM servers and computers. They are also compatible with most other standard brands as well. These server racks meet the EIA standards for 19" server racks.The width of the rack is the standard 24" width used in Data Centers and the 48" depth allows for additional PDUs and cable management.
